_comment: Claude Code hooks for tg-ping. Copy into .claude/settings.json, or merge the hooks block into an existing file. Claude Code hands each hook a JSON document on stdin, which --no-stdin leaves unread. Grok runs these hooks too, so the titles name no agent: tg-ping names the one that sends each message on its first line. Author: Dr. Denys Dutykh (Mathematics Department, Khalifa University of Science and Technology, Abu Dhabi, UAE).
